result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred playbook position: fixed 12-month automatic renewals, a 30-day non-renewal notice requirement, a Vendor reminder at least 60 days before renewal, and renewal increases capped at the lesser of CPI and 3%. Retaining either party’s non-renewal right preserves the original reciprocal structure and does not impair Customer’s opt-out right. The changes are limited to the renewal protections required by the playbook and are professionally drafted, though the applicable CPI could be defined more precisely.
